## Outcome
pilobol.us is served from its S3 projection bucket through the existing papyrus-edge-pilobol-us distribution; publishing an edit updates the live site in seconds; the Amplify reader dpdg1mg84dlwb is no longer used.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 9 (Migration, Pilobol.us).

## Checklist
- [ ] Pilobol.us site config: backend.publication.kind = "s3-projection"; deploy CMS backend (create-only for the new resources)
- [ ] renditions --all; project-all into the bucket
- [ ] Parity: projected bucket vs today's reader output from the same export (byte-identical) and vs live (capture.py compare)
- [ ] Swap the reader origin on papyrus-edge-pilobol-us to the bucket (OAC) and attach the function; rollback = swap back
- [ ] Remove PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID; time Save -> Live for a test edit
- [ ] Hand the reader app to Ryan for deletion

## Acceptance
- curl https://pilobol.us/ and every sitemap URL: 200, same content-type, HTML sha256 equal to the projected bucket objects.
- A test edit in newsroom.pilobol.us is visible on pilobol.us within 60 s; mutation response has live:true.

## Out of scope
Anth.us; deleting the reader app (Ryan).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1, M2, M3, M4.

## Risk
Low (pre-production; move fast, brief downtime acceptable).

## Estimate
3-5 agent-hours.
description.to:
## Outcome
Readers see an edit within about a minute of Save, without blanket invalidations, and today's staleness sources are removed.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 2 (Atomicity, versioning, caching).

## Checklist
- [ ] HTML Cache-Control public, max-age=0, s-maxage=86400 set as S3 object metadata; renditions/versioned CSS-JS max-age=31536000, immutable
- [ ] Targeted CreateInvalidation of written paths (both /x/ and /x/index.html forms); measure completion time
- [ ] Fallback switch: s-maxage=60 without invalidation if invalidations prove slow
- [ ] Record and fix today's staleness findings: Pretext s-maxage=3600 plus the Amplify CDN layer; Pilobol.us reader distribution on CachingOptimized (1-day default TTL) with nothing invalidating it
- [ ] Monthly invalidation path count alarm (first 1000 free)

## Acceptance
- After a test edit, curl of the item URL and home through the site hostname shows the new content within 60 s (measured, 5 runs).
- No /* invalidations issued by the projector (CloudTrail check).

## Out of scope
Pretext revalidation redesign beyond documenting/fixing the TTL.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1.

## Risk
Invalidation latency/cost if edit volume grows.

## Estimate
2-3 agent-hours.
